title: Print Solutions
subject: PRINT SOLUTIONS
description: Printer and multifunction device types, cost per page, consumables, managed print services, and secure printing.

lessons.title: Printer and multifunction device types
lessons.body:
Printers are chosen by volume, quality, and use:

- **Laser:** fast, good for high-volume text, lower cost per page at scale.
- **Inkjet:** lower upfront cost, suited to low to medium volume and colour work.
- **Multifunction device (MFD):** combines print, copy, scan, and fax in one unit, common in offices.
- **Large format:** plotters and wide-format printers for drawings and posters.

A device chosen for the wrong volume will cost more to run and will need replacing sooner.

lessons.title: Cost per page and consumables
lessons.body:
The true cost of printing is the cost per page, not the purchase price. Cost per page includes toner or ink, drums, paper, service, and power, divided by the number of pages printed.

Consumables such as toner, drums, and fuser units are the main recurring cost. Compare yields (pages per cartridge) using the same standard, and include original versus refilled consumables in the comparison, with their warranty implications.

lessons.title: Managed print services
lessons.body:
A managed print service (MPS) is a contract to manage the customer's printing fleet. The supplier assesses the current fleet, right-sizes devices, supplies consumables, and reports usage and cost.

MPS suits customers with many devices, dispersed sites, or rising print costs. The sales conversation starts with an assessment of current devices, volumes, and costs, then proposes a fleet plan with a clear service level and a monthly report.

lessons.title: Secure printing and discovery questions
lessons.body:
Printers store documents and can be a security weak point. Secure printing options include user authentication at the device (so jobs print only when the user is present), encrypted storage, and disabling unused network ports and services.

Discovery questions:

- How many pages are printed each month, per device and per department?
- What is the current cost per page, including consumables and service?
- Which documents are confidential, and who collects printouts?
- How are devices serviced today, and how quickly are faults resolved?
